evidence.evidence_text: Inspired by these insights, we adopt an interdisciplinary research perspective and propose using LLM-based agents to study Homans’ SET.
Specifically, we construct a virtual society composed of three LLM agents and have them engage in a social exchange game to observe their behaviors.
